title: Roguelike Dungeon Loot Table Board
summary: Loot table planning board for rarity, risk, reward cadence, room types, and replayability.
prompt: Create a roguelike dungeon loot and room-generation board for {argument name="game_title" default="Lantern Below"}. Show room archetypes, rarity bands, chest logic, cursed items, shop nodes, boss rewards, procedural fairness rules, exploit prevention, and reward cadence across a 20-minute run. Use a visual matrix with icons, rarity colors, and concise balance annotations.
